defective_pattern: Authoring table captions split across two separate lines instead of unified single-line
why_defective: Violates Persian academic formatting standards which dictate a single unified line for table numbering and titles.
observed_symptoms: Table number on one line, table title on the next
corrective_remedy: Format table captions strictly as 'جدول [فصل]- [شماره]: [عنوان]' on a single continuous line.

detection_heuristic.trigger_rule: Detecting split table captions using hard breaks or multiple paragraphs for a single caption.
